title: XROS 4 Nano Kit – 2ml
description:
Vaporesso XROS 4 NANO — With the largest battery in the Xros Family, is the first XROS to feature a 1.3” TFT color screen. It offers a 1350 mAh battery, 2A fast charging, button operation, and adjustable airflow all in one device. COREX 2.0 technology in the 0.4-ohm pod provides richer flavor and longer pod life, supported by the stable Axon chip. It is fully compatible with all XROS pods.

Key Features:

- Largest battery in the Xros Family with 1350 mAh capacity

- First XROS device featuring a 1.3” TFT color screen

- 2A fast charging for quick power-ups

- Button operation for easy control

- Adjustable airflow for a customizable experience

- COREX 2.0 technology in the 0.4-ohm pod for richer flavor and longer pod life

- Powered by the stable Axon chip

- Fully compatible with all XROS pods

Specifications:
Dimensions: 55.3 x 20.9 x 79.9mm
Battery: 1350mAh
Output Power: 30W MAX
Charging Current: Type-C, 2A
Large, easy-to-read 1.3” TFT color screen
2mL pod capacity (3mL pod is available for purchase separately)
Fully compatible with all XROS pods

Package Contents:
1x VAPORESSO XROS 4 NANO Battery
1x VAPORESSO XROS Series 0.4Ω MESH POD (Pre-install)
1x VAPORESSO XROS Series 0.8Ω MESH POD (In-box)
1x TYPE-C Cable
1x User Manual & Warranty Card
1x Lanyard
